slug: 2024-07-10 Tanzania ramps up national physical address registration

systems.owner: Ministry of Information, Communication and Information Technology
systems.tiers: national; said to reach 85 percent of Tanzanians by July 2024, with addresses given to residences, hospitals, shops, schools, banks and other institutions; no local government tier stated

note: A national address register run by the communications ministry; the document says nothing of local government offices or their connection.
